===Usage instructions===
{{Tlp|1st|''simultaneous appearances''}}

'''Please note that audiobooks with the same release date as the parent media should ''not'' be listed as simultaneous in this template and its siblings; instead, {{Tl|Ab}} should be used between the media link and this template to denote an audiobook.'''

==Example(s)==
{{Template:1st|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''The Clone Wars'' novelization]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]]}}
===Code===
<code><nowiki>
{{1st|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''The Clone Wars'' novelization]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]]}}
</nowiki></code>
